jobs.description: Start your career as a Technical Production Employee in Echt and learn a versatile technical trade on the job. You will work on high-quality conveyor belts in an informal working environment where craftsmanship and quality come first. In return, you will receive a gross monthly salary of up to €2,700, work day shifts, and have the opportunity to secure a permanent contract with the employer after demonstrating your skills. Apply today!Your responsibilities include:    - Processing materials by cutting, punching, sealing, and pressing    - Operating production machines and using hand tools    - Performing quality inspections on finished products    - Supporting various production departments    - Working together with colleagues to keep the production process running smoothly    - Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized workplaceWhat's in it for you?    - Gross monthly salary between €2,600 and €2,700    - Travel allowance according to the employer's reimbursement scheme    - Pension accrual through Manpower    - Temporary employment contract through Manpower    - Fast-track opportunity for a permanent contract with the employer based on good performance    - Full-time or part-time position of 32 to 40 hours per week    - Thorough on-the-job training and opportunities to further develop your technical skills    - Technical insight or an affinity for technology    - Accurate working style and attention to detail    - Motivation to learn and develop your skills    - Ability to work independently as well as in a team    - Good command of the English language, as English is the primary language spoken on the work floorReady to take the next step as a Technical Production Employee in Echt? Apply today, and Manpower will contact you as soon as possible after receiving your application.
